name: spellkave_export
label: Export Manifest
description: Reconstruct a live bundle via r_export_manifest (ADR-0086 snapshot semantics, ADR-0149 publisher only) and write TOML. The caller must be the module publisher; any other caller is refused with MF-EXPORT-001. Optional actor= keeps only that entity and what hangs off it (containment, owned_by, equipment). Requires a live connection. Pass exactly one of out= or out_dir=.

actor.description: entity_key of the hero to keep. When set, only that actor and what hangs off it remain.

out.description: Write the rendered TOML to this file path.

out_dir.description: Write <slug>.toml into this directory (slug from --actor, else the bundle id).

promptSnippet: Export a live bundle (optionally one actor) to TOML via r_export_manifest
promptGuidelines: spellkave_export: call with bundle= and out= (or out_dir=) after --live is wired.
spellkave_export: pass actor= to keep only that hero and hanging items/tags/state.

examples.description: export the staged hero as a standalone TOML save

limitations: Publisher whole-world export; unavailable on hosted user routes.
